api-design.description: Designs REST and GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI specs, error contracts, pagination, versioning, and security.

c4-architecture.description: Generates and validates C4 architecture diagrams — context, container, component, and code level views.

data-pipeline.description: Designs and reviews ETL/ELT data pipelines — schema design, transformations, orchestration, monitoring, and data quality.

database-migration.description: Plans and executes database migrations — schema changes, data migrations, zero-downtime strategies, and rollback plans.

docker-compose.description: Designs and reviews Docker Compose configurations — multi-service setups, networking, volumes, health checks, and production hardening.

github-actions.description: Designs and reviews GitHub Actions workflows — CI/CD pipelines, matrix builds, caching, secrets, reusable workflows, and security hardening.

graphql-schema.description: Designs and reviews GraphQL schemas — types, resolvers, pagination, error handling, performance, and security.

incident-response.description: Guides production incident handling — triage, mitigation, root cause analysis, and postmortem.

kubernetes.description: Designs and reviews Kubernetes deployments — manifests, Helm charts, scaling, networking, security, and troubleshooting.

monorepo-management.description: Manages monorepo structure — workspace config, dependency graph, changesets, selective builds, and package publishing.

nginx-config.description: Designs and reviews Nginx configurations — reverse proxy, load balancing, SSL/TLS, rate limiting, and security headers.

observability.description: Designs observability stacks — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and SLO/SLI definitions.

playwright-testing.description: Designs and implements Playwright E2E tests — page objects, fixtures, assertions, visual regression, and CI integration.

redis-patterns.description: Designs Redis usage patterns — caching strategies, pub/sub, rate limiting, sessions, distributed locks, and data structures.

retrospective.description: Facilitates sprint/project retrospectives — what went well, what to improve, action items with owners.

risk-assessment.description: Scores pipeline risks, validates commits for security issues, and detects secret leaks before push.

terraform.description: Designs and reviews Terraform/OpenTofu IaC — modules, state management, provider config, security, and drift detection.

problem-management.description: ITIL v4 Problem Management — adapted (not verbatim) from @windyroad/itil (MIT); self-contained, tool-agnostic
